description: Rule A: AlphaGenome merged splicing score (DeepMind-recommended composite) = max(splice_sites) + max(splice_site_usage) + max(splice_junctions)/5, aggregated across all tracks and genes as max(|raw_score|). 1MB interval centred on each of 60 frozen variants. GRCh38. Scored 2026-09-20 (re-run confirmed identical SHA to 2026-09-15 scoring; AlphaGenome API is deterministic).

Rule B: AlphaGenome OSF-preregistered per-junction score = max(|raw_score|) from SpliceJunctionScorer at the junction closest to variant position, filtered to pre-declared cell-context ontology set {UBERON:0002048 lung, UBERON:0002185 bronchus, CL:0002145, CL:1000271, CL:0002632} — see docs/protocol/AMENDMENTS.md amendment #2. 60/60 variants scored, 0 NA. 1MB interval, GRCh38. Scored 2026-09-20.
